frame: base_link: the drone's body, FLU (x forward, y left, z up), origin at the Iris model's origin. Poses are translation [x, y, z] in metres and rotation [axis x, y, z, angle] (Webots axis-angle).

imu.name: imu
imu.note: noise: absolute standard deviation per sample (m/s^2, rad/s), added by the controller's stream from the seed. ArduPilot keeps the Iris's own noiseless accelerometer, gyro, inertial unit and GPS.

lidar.name: lidar
lidar.model: Livox Mid-360 class: 360 x 59 degrees (-7 to +52), 0.1 to 40 m
lidar.note: Webots renders a 360-degree Lidar from several cameras and misplaces returns when tiltAngle is set (checked on a recorded flight): it renders render_layers over a symmetric field instead, and the stream keeps the top 'layers' (+52.3 to -6.7 degrees).
